Specification: This module specifies a disk-based variant of Synod/Paxos in which processes interact through persistent disks and maintain local phase, block, and read/write bookkeeping state. The model assumes each process has a disjoint positive ballot set, a distinguished set of disks with a majority predicate, and requires that any two disk majorities intersect. The specification defines initialization, phase-0 recovery reads, phase-1 and phase-2 writes and reads, ballot restarts, and failures, then verifies that the overall behavior refinement-style implies the imported SynodSpec theorem target.
IfThenElse:
IF disk [d ][q].mbal < dblock [p].mbal
     THEN /\ blocksRead' = 
                [blocksRead EXCEPT
                    ![p][d ] = @ \cup {[block |-> disk [d ][q], proc |-> q]}]
          /\ UNCHANGED <<input, output, disk , phase, dblock , disksWritten>>
     ELSE StartBallot(p)

IF nonInitBlks = {} THEN input[p]
                       ELSE maxBlk .inp
FunctionConstructor:
[mbal : (UNION {Ballot(p) : p \in Proc}) \cup {0},
              bal  : (UNION {Ballot(p) : p \in Proc}) \cup {0},
              inp  : Inputs \cup {NotAnInput}]
FunctionOverride:
[dblock EXCEPT
                ![p].bal = dblock [p].mbal,
                ![p].inp =
                    LET blocksSeen == allBlocksRead(p) \cup {dblock [p]}
                        nonInitBlks ==
                            {bs \in blocksSeen : bs.inp # NotAnInput}
                        maxBlk ==
                            CHOOSE b \in nonInitBlks :
                                \A c \in nonInitBlks : b.bal >= c.bal
                    IN IF nonInitBlks = {} THEN input[p]
                       ELSE maxBlk .inp ]

[dblock EXCEPT
                        ![p] = [(CHOOSE r \in allBlocksRead (p) :
                                     \A s \in allBlocksRead (p) : r .bal >= s.bal)
                                  EXCEPT !.mbal = b]]

[(CHOOSE r \in allBlocksRead (p) :
                                     \A s \in allBlocksRead (p) : r .bal >= s.bal)
                                  EXCEPT !.mbal = b]
